description: `activity nudge` (hub-only) types NUDGE_PROMPT into a permitted recipient's live orchestrator pane and confirms it landed — `mv_engine::fleet_start::FleetState::fetch`/`orchestrator_agent` to find the pane by name, `mv_engine::runner::deliver_prompt_to` to send and confirm. This needs a live fake-herdr pane/agent, not just an ordered call/reply transcript, so it is seeded against the real stateful `fake-herdr` binary via `herdr_seed` (card 20261103-b-64e792) rather than `fake_herdr.py`'s strict transcript player.
